observations.what: Issuer published as 'Material Quikrete Holdings Inc' (5 quarters) and 'Material Summit Materials LLC' (3 quarters): the filer's heading 'Construction Material' (singular) is not a known industry label, so the member split kept 'Material'. Fixed by adding 'Construction Material' to this wrapper's extra_industry_labels; the label list is a union over all wrappers, and no other cohort fund's identifier in spon3 contains 'Construction Material' without the s.
observations.suggested_check: An issuer name whose first word equals the last word of the row's extracted_industry.

quote.text: Construction Material Quikrete Holdings Inc(7) First lien senior secured term loan SOFR + 2.50 % 4/14/2031 5,970 5,993 5,970 2.12 %

detection_decision.rationale: The gate's industry_in_name test looks for the whole industry label at the start of the name; a partial label ('Material ...' under 'Construction Material') passes it. Matching the first word of the name against the last word of extracted_industry catches this shape; false positives would be names like 'Software Inc' under 'Software', which are rare and readable.

observations.what: The filer tags the money fund's yield (2024-09-30 4.84, 2024-12-31 4.36) and the Treasury bill's yield (2024-12-31 4.27) with InvestmentBasisSpreadVariableRate, so they published as SOFR + yield, floating, with a guessed reference rate. Fixed by 13 row corrections (spread and reference withdrawn; bill rate 4.27, fixed).
observations.suggested_check: A CASH-class row with a basis_spread or a reference rate.

detection_decision.rationale: Money funds and bills have no benchmark; a spread on a CASH row is always a tag misuse. No false positives expected outside floating-rate cash notes, which the cohort does not class CASH.

quote.text: Triwest Healthcare Alliance Corp(6)(11)(12) First lien senior secured delayed draw term loan SOFR + 5.50 % 12/27/2027 - ( 608 ) ( 656 ) ( 0.23 )%

detection_decision.rationale: C107 now fires on the corrected negative cost (check-accepted), not on the wrong positive cost; cost_conservation did not flag a 1.2M gap at 2024-09-30. A sign-mismatch check (fair value < 0 and cost > 0 on a row with par 0 or dash) is cheap and has few false positives (a written-up undrawn line is rare).
detection_decision.reference: proposal: row_validation sign check fv<0 and cost>0 with zero/dash par

observations.what: issuer_name_printed (pipeline/candidate_rules.issuer_name_differs_from_page) treats a cell holding only an em dash (U+2014) as a name cell: _STOP_SYMBOLS admits the ASCII hyphen but not U+2012-U+2015 or U+2212. On Overland's bill rows the dash follows the label cell, so the rule reports not_the_printed_name (2024-12-31, 2025-03-31) on a correct name. Shared step, may misfire on any filer printing an em-dash placeholder after the company or label.
observations.suggested_check: Unit test in tests for candidate_rules: a printed row 'Label | — | 4.27% | ...' with issuer 'Label' passes; a real different name still flags.

detection_decision.rationale: A false alarm in a detector; recurrence is caught by a regression test on the rule (dash-only cells of any dash code point are stop cells), not by a data rule.

observations.what: Page rules join printed rows by member text; a row named by the wrapper's context_identifiers (no InvestmentIdentifierAxis member) gets no printed_row, and issuer_name_printed falls to its shape test, which flags a name equal to a fund label even though the page prints it as the name (bill rows 2025-06-30, 2025-09-30, 2025-12-31, 2026-06-30). observations.suggested_check: Join page-rule printed rows by context id (the <tr> carrying the row's fair-value fact) when the member text is absent; count rows without a printed row per fund-quarter in the blind-spot table.

detection_decision.rationale: The blind-spot table (page_rules_name_blind_spots.csv) already counts rows with no printed row but does not stop the shape test flagging them; a context-id join removes the blind spot.
